assembly: executed: inside the published statement Certified.events.Final.final (Shapes.Equiv and Resources over Target.runWith of the exact bytes); Proofs/: decoded only: events.Proofs.Assembly (the bytecode decodes to the final EVM IR's instructions; no execution theorem)

statuses.equivalence: proved (published statement, Shapes.Equiv): at every gas below 2^256 every result of the exact bytecode on a valid call is the source's, or a failure that changes nothing (out of gas or a revert, whatever its data); such a failure only below the gas bound, and from the bound on exactly the source's, revert data included (Shapes.EquivG, Shapes.Certified.equivG)
statuses.termination: proved (published statement, Shapes.Terminates): the source ends on every valid call with an allowed status; the bytecode too, at gas from the bound on
statuses.spec: proved (published statement, Shapes.Meets of Shapes.bundlePost of the specification solar-verify exported in this run, NonVacuous in the statement): the specification of every source result on a valid call, hence of every bytecode result that is not an inert failure
statuses.resources: proved (published statement, Shapes.Resources): from the gas bound on, below 2^64, the bytecode gives the source's result
excluded: deployment: the init code is not covered; the statement is about the runtime bytecode from any storage that writes the slots the constructor writes
source model trusted: SolidCore's checked contract (the solc AST through scripts/solc_ast_to_lean_source.py and the type checker) is the meaning of the source (frontend trust boundary)
calls: one frame, caller 0x2000, contract at 0x1000, the block and transaction of Target.message; no external calls, GAS reads or return data in the code (the loop checker's fragment)
gas: the bound is the loop checker's (22100 per item times the final EVM IR's block fuel, plus memory), coarse; below it the bytecode may fail without effects, which equivalence admits
valid calls: the functions of Events.fns ABI-encoded with clean argument words, any value below 2^256, any storage; other call data is outside the statement
